Alle Einstellungen gehen auch ohne Fenst:
Every setting also works without this window:
  walkie settings          interactive menu
  walkie set KEY VALUE     set a single value
  walkie list --json       everything for scripts and AI agents
Alles Weitere findest du per Rechtsklick: Everything else: right-click the figure → Settings, or run walkie help in a terminal.
Dein Bluetooth-Kopfhörer ist Lautspreche: Your Bluetooth headphones are speaker, microphone and remote control in one.
Der Begleiter muss laufen, damit er die: The companion has to be running to hear the buttons.
Drück Play (oder klick auf die Figur) –: Press Play (or click the figure) – speak after the ping.
Drück jetzt eine Taste am Kopfhörer – ei: Press a button on your headphones now – once, twice or long …
Ein Bluetooth-Kopfhörer-Mikro erscheint: A Bluetooth headset mic only appears once it is active.
A Bluetooth headset microphone only shows up while it is active. With a different microphone, the headphones keep their good sound quality.
Einige Änderungen greifen erst nach eine: Some changes only take effect after a restart.
Er läuft in deinen Terminals; ich höre m: It runs in your terminals; I listen in, read aloud and pass on your spoken approvals. You can add more agents later.
Erkannt: {key} · {gesture}. Wähle in der: Detected: {key} · {gesture}. Choose what should happen in the highlighted cell.
Erlaubt dem Walkie, die Tasten deines Bl: Lets Walkie read the buttons of your Bluetooth headphones (one time, asks for your password).
Fertig. So redest du mit mir:: Done. This is how we talk:
Frag mich einfach, was gerade los ist –: Just ask me what is going on – short or detailed, as you like.
Fragt eine Session nach einer Freigabe,: When a session asks for permission, say yes, no or what should happen instead.
Freigeschaltet 🎧 Falls die Tasten nicht: Unlocked 🎧 If the buttons don't work right away: reconnect your headphones.
Hörst du mich – höre ich dich?: Can you hear me – can I hear you?
Ich schicke deinen Satz an die passende: I send what you say to the right session, open a new one or answer myself.
In drei Schritten zu „mit {name} per Kop: Three steps to “talking to {name} through your headphones”.
In welcher Sprache sollen wir reden? Men: Which language shall we speak? Menus, announcements, speech recognition and voice follow this choice.
Not a sprite folder: AnimData.xml is missing.
Keine Taste erkannt. Ist der Kopfhörer v: No button detected. Are your headphones connected?
Click a figure to use it. Fox, frog and slime are free pixel art (CC0) – credits in figures/CREDITS.md.
Kurze Probeaufnahme mit Pegel und erkann: A short test recording with level and recognized text – for example after connecting a headset.
Lege fest, was die Tasten deines Bluetoo: Choose what the buttons on your Bluetooth headphones do.
Mikrofon, Spracherkennung, Stimme und KI: Microphone, speech recognition, voice and AI models.
Mit welchem Coding-Agent arbeitest du?: Which coding agent do you work with?
Mitgelieferte Figuren (frei, CC0) oder e: Bundled figures (free, CC0) or your own sprites in the same format – see figures/CREDITS.md.
Musik-Aktionen steuern deinen Player dir: Music actions control your player directly – so play/pause, next and previous keep working as usual. “Twice” and “long” don't work on every headset: just try them with “Learn button”.
Nach der Frage ertönt ein steigender Ton: After the question you hear a rising tone: speak now. A falling tone ends listening. Yes/no, options and free answers are understood.
Nimmt kurz auf, zeigt den Pegel und was: Records briefly and shows the level and what Whisper understands.
Records briefly and shows the level and what I understood.
Play am Kopfhörer, Klick auf die Figur o: Play on your headphones, a click on the figure or the hotkey: ding = speak. If a question is open, you answer it (yes/no/option). Otherwise your sentence goes to the right Claude session – or Walkie answers itself. Falling tone = done listening.
Play heißt: ich höre zu. Ohne Kopfhörer: Play means: I'm listening. Without headphones, click the figure or use the hotkey.
Sehr leise – ein anderes Mikro wählen?: Very quiet – choose a different microphone?
Sprich einen Satz zur Probe – du siehst: Say a test sentence – you'll see right away what was understood.
Vom Mikrofon kommt nichts an – ein ander: Nothing is coming from the microphone – choose another one?
Was die Figur ansagt und wie du per Stim: What the figure announces and how you answer by voice – even without a screen.
Wer im Terminal arbeitet und wann der Be: Who works in the terminal and when the companion starts.
Wähle dein Mikrofon und sprich einen Sat: Pick your microphone and say a test sentence. You'll see right away what I understood.
Zustand des Begleiters und Hilfe bei Pro: Companion status and help with problems.
pkexec fehlt – der Befehl liegt in der Z: pkexec is missing – the command is on your clipboard (run it once in a terminal).
